description:
Offline loyalty card wallet made for French shops. Scan, store, show.
Encarté keeps your loyalty cards on your phone and shows their barcode at checkout. Nothing else. It is made for France: written in French first, and tuned for French shops.

Made for France
• 224 French store brands recognized (Carrefour, E.Leclerc, Intermarché, Monoprix, Decathlon, Fnac…): type the store name and the card gets its color.
• Search that forgives French spelling: accents, case, punctuation and spaces are ignored, so "e leclerc" finds "E.Leclerc".
• Import your cards from FidMe, the most widely used loyalty card app in France.
• French first, fully translated into English.

Everything else
• Works fully offline: the app has no Internet permission.
• Scan a card with the camera, pick a screenshot, or type the number.
• Import your cards from a Wallet pass or a PDF.
• QR, EAN, UPC, Code 128/39/93, Codabar, ITF, Aztec, Data Matrix and PDF417.
• Full brightness while a card is shown.
• Expiry dates, archive, and contactless payment blocked while a card is shown.
• Photos of the front and back of your cards.
• Favorites, search and sorting.
• Groups, a widget and shortcuts to open a card in one tap.
• Backups in Catima's format, optionally encrypted (AES-256): move to or from Catima at any time.
• Optional lock with fingerprint, face or screen lock.

Free software (GPL-3.0-or-later). No ads, no tracking, no account.
